title: Pipe shop vs one shared picture
caption: Left is a civil shop that treats software as support, so the dashboard sits unused. Right is the same pipes, with crews, the control room, and capital looking at one picture.
note: Conceptual framework, not a measured comparison of any utility or vendor. NextEra’s capital markets differ from municipal water; the transferable lesson is identity, not scale.

title: Sense → act → measure → compare
caption: Sense, then suggest, then a person decides, then you measure again. The station does not run itself because someone bought a model.
note: Conceptual loop, not a control narrative for any plant. Does not imply automatic causation or unmanned operation.

title: Question → shared catalog → owner
caption: The question has to land in a shared catalog with a named owner. Buying the software is the easy part. Owning what the data means is the work.
note: Conceptual route, not a product architecture or compliance certification.

title: Hidden map → shared map
caption: Left is what only one operator knows. Right is that same knowledge written down, findable, and owned. A model cannot retrieve what the utility never recorded.
note: Conceptual before/after, not a claim that any catalog is complete or that documentation replaces experienced judgment.

title: Design for the swap
caption: The meaning and the platform rules sit in one place. SCADA, GIS, and the work-order system stay replaceable. If you cannot swap a system, the integration is the risk.
note: Illustrative architecture sketch, not a recommendation of specific vendors or a requirement to consolidate all data into one database.

title: Supervised pilot → evidence gate → expansion
caption: A supervised pilot, then evidence, then a wider rollout. Nobody gets more autonomy without a named person who can stop it.
note: Conceptual control path, not a safety case or regulatory approval process. People retain the decision.

title: Systems Lens loop for utility AI
caption: Identity, meaning, access, and audit are shared. Tuesday’s work stays with the crew that does it.
note: Conceptual loop of responsibilities and feedback, not automatic causation or guaranteed trust.

title: Snapshot vs operating curve
caption: The flat line is what you spent. The curve is whether anything in the system actually moved after the purchase.
note: Conceptual comparison, not a measured utility KPI series, and not proof of causation. Post-intervention change requires evidence and judgment.

title: Seven truths · one operating system
caption: Seven truths drawn as one system. Identity sits first. The other six do not hold if that piece is missing.
note: Conceptual systems map, not a scored maturity model and not a ranking of utilities or vendors.
